How do I reset my password?
To reset your password, go to Settings > Security > Change Password. Enter your current password, then your new password twice. Click Save to confirm the change.

San Francisco has amazing dining options! For fine dining, try Atelier Crenn or Benu. For casual spots, check out Tartine Bakery or Burma Superstar. The Ferry Building also has great food stalls.
What's your opinion on the stock market right now?

The stock market has been quite volatile recently. Tech stocks have shown strong performance, while traditional sectors have been more mixed. Many analysts suggest diversifying your portfolio across different sectors. I'd recommend looking into index funds if you're just starting out.

Cryptocurrency can be a high-risk, high-reward investment. Bitcoin and Ethereum are the most established options. However, I'd suggest only investing what you can afford to lose and doing thorough research before making any decisions.
